title: Klimagerechtigkeit als politischer Aushandlungsraum
subtitle: Konfliktlinien zwischen den Gerechtigkeitsauffassungen der EU und Chinas
description: This paper sheds light on a key point of contention within the international climate regime: the differing normative understandings of distributive climate justice held by the two ‘climate leaders’ – the EU and China. Drawing on the theoretical framework of American pragmatism, the convictions guiding the actions of both actors are identified through sequential analysis of their written submissions to the 2025 ‘ICJ Climate Opinion’ and compared side by side. This reveals significant divergences in their views on the fair distribution of mitigation burdens. The author conducts research in the field of international climate policy, with a particular interest in matters of climate justice.

title: Knowledge Is Rhythm
subtitle: Versifying Philosophy in Wolof Sufi Poetry
description: How can poetry convey philosophy and embody knowledge? This book addresses this question through a study of Wolofal, the Islamic religious poetry in Wolof that flourished with the rise of the Muridiyya brotherhood in Senegal. By focusing on four key poets—Samba Jaara Mbay, Moor Kayre, Mbay Jaxate, and Muusaa Ka—it shows how their works articulated the concept of xam-xam (knowledge) as both spiritual insight and lived practice. Drawing on original translations and close readings, the study highlights how Wolofal represents a synthesis of Wolof and Arabic traditions, where rhythm and form are inseparable from meaning. Rather than applying external frameworks, it lets the texts themselves reveal their philosophical depth, demonstrating that poetry was not only a literary form but also a vehicle of education, proselytism, and cultural innovation. By analysing how knowledge becomes rhythm and action, this book sheds new light on African Sufi literature and contributes to broader debates on philosophy, religion, and indigenous epistemologies. It will be of interest to scholars and students in African studies, Islamic studies, literature, and philosophy, as well as readers curious about the intersections of language, poetry, and spirituality.

title: Konstruktive Auslegung mechanisch zu fügender Strukturen am Beispiel des Clinchens artgleicher Materialien
description: Die stetige Entwicklung ressourceneffizienter und nachhaltiger Leichtbaukonzepte erfordert heutzutage oftmals den Einsatz wandlungsfähiger Fertigungstechnologien. Insbesondere beim Fügen von Multi-Material-Kombinationen kommen etablierte Verfahren wie das Schweißen gegenwärtig oftmals an deren Grenzen. Mechanische Fügetechnologien, wie das Clinchen oder Nieten bieten hier eine leistungsfähige Alternative. Sollen Baugruppen im Rahmen einer Produktentwicklung für ein definiertes Anforderungsprofil ausgelegt werden, fehlen jedoch oft Standards und Merkblätter, auf welche Konstrukteure zurückgreifen können. Aus diesem Grund fokussiert die vorliegende Arbeit die Erforschung eines Vorgehensmodells zur konstruktiven Auslegung mechanisch zu fügender Strukturen. Mittels wissensbasierter und datengetriebener Methoden soll der Produktentwickler von der initialen Aufgabenerfassung bis hin zur Erzeugung erster Produktentwürfe konstruktionsbegleitend unterstützt werden. Dies umfasst neben dem Training maschineller Lernverfahren vor allem den Aufbau einer rechnerverarbeitbaren Wissensbasis. Entsprechend lassen sich bereits vor der finalen Produktausarbeitung wichtige Rückschlüsse zur Anforderungserfüllung und Fügbarkeit einer Konstruktion ziehen. Durch die Implementierung eines wissensbasierten Assistenzsystems lässt sich zudem die Übertragbarkeit der entwickelten Methoden in ein digitales System überprüfen und deren Anwendung anhand einer exemplarischen Fügeaufgabe demonstrieren. Stellvertretend für den Bereich der mechanischen Fügeverfahren steht demnach die Auslegung einer Clinchverbindung unter Berücksichtigung artgleicher Werkstoff-Dicken-Kombinationen und quasi-statischer Lasteinwirkungen im Fokus. Zusammenfassend leistet die vorliegende Arbeit einen grundlegenden Beitrag für die konstruktive Auslegung mechanisch zu fügender Strukturen. Durch den dargestellten Ansatz wird der Konstrukteur bereits in den frühen Phasen der Produktentwicklung unterstützt und der Weg hin zu hochwertigen Erstentwürfen nach dem ”First-Time-Right"-Prinzip geebnet.

description: Kurd:innen finden in diskriminierungskritischen Diskursen wenig Beachtung. Obwohl sie eine der zahlenmäßig größten Zuwanderungsgruppen in Deutschland darstellen, ist kaum etwas darüber bekannt, dass antikurdischer Rassismus weit verbreitet ist. Um dies zu ändern, beleuchten renommierte Wissenschaftler:innen das Themenfeld aus verschiedenen Perspektiven: Was entsteht, sind gebündelte Diskursbeiträge, die für die spezifische Situation von Kurd:innen sensibilisieren und das fachliche Engagement gegen Rassismus stärken. Es sind starke Stimmen, die dazu dienen, das spezifische Phänomen der kurdischen Rassismus- und Diskriminierungserfahrung im Gesamtkontext von Marginalisierung, Dethematisierung, Intersektionalität und Nicht-Anerkennung in Deutschland sichtbar zu machen.

title: L’umorismo tra sacro e profano : attualità e prospettive di ricerca
description: Engaging in a critical dialogue with traditional interpretations of the sacred, theologians, linguists, historians, and philosophers have been invited to reconstruct the fabric of the delicate relationship between humour and transcendence and characterize laughter as a two-way catalyst in the relationship between humanity and God. The essays collected in this volume prove that laughter and humour are not marginal or subversive elements in relation to the sacred, but are instead capable of shedding light on the relationship between the human and the divine. From the «God who laughs»—gleaned from comparisons with the ancient world—to humour as the language of friendship between God and humankind, and on to the modern rediscovery of comic elements in the Bible, a common thread emerges: laughter as a cognitive tool. In contemporary multimodal texts—queer representations of the divine or cinematic reworkings that play with the conventions of orthodoxy—humour proves to be the most effective tool for destabilizing hierarchies, challenging gender norms, and redefining the contemporary religious imagination. Throughout the essays, the comic does not negate the sacred: it questions, transforms, and opens it to new spaces of meaning—inclusive and dialogic— acting not only as a key to understanding the relationships that humans maintain with the transcendent, but also as an interpretive framework for the meanings and tensions that characterize our existence.

title: La mediación escolar en los conflictos de adolescentes ecuatorianos en los colegios de la Ciudad de Machala
description: The work addresses student conflicts in schools in the city of Machala, Ecuador; situations that have become a topic of debate in recent decades. To determine the problematic situation, it was necessary to carry out a field study, which required interviews with students, parents and teachers from the different educational centers selected for this purpose. Among the main findings we find that a wide range of conflicts are present in daily school life, a situation that allowed us to determine that the complexity of society is directly reflected in the school, which, as a mirror, observes how the foundations of knowledge and wisdom have to share ideological spaces with practical aspects and social conflicts. In this framework, school mediation and restorative practices are conceived as tools that contribute to preventing escalation towards situations of violence and at the same time constitute an opportunity to train adolescents and young people for life in democracy, peace and human rights.

title: La última ilusión
subtitle: La crisis de la revolución en América Latina, 1979-1991
description: La última ilusión. La crisis de la revolución en América Latina, 1979-1991 analiza el ocaso de los proyectos revolucionarios latinoamericanos a partir de la experiencia del sandinismo en Nicaragua. Por medio de fuentes periodísticas de la época y un trabajo crítico, este ensayo examina cómo la izquierda latinoamericana transitó de la esperanza transformadora a la crisis ideológica y política que marcó el final del siglo XX.A través de enclaves históricos como las tensiones entre revolución y democracia, el impacto de la Guerra Fría y la influencia del imperialismo estadounidense en la desestabilización de los movimientos revolucionarios, Valeria Manzano centra su eje analítico en el triunfo y posterior derrota electoral del Frente Sandinista de Liberación Nacional, símbolo de una generación que buscaba reconciliar la utopía con la práctica democrática.Esta obra es una reflexión sobre la persistencia de las ideas y la nostalgia del cambio. Con un enfoque interdisciplinario contribuye a la comprensión de la política, la memoria y los desafíos contemporáneos de América Latina.

title: Land Use Planning and Management for a Sustainable Future
description: Land Use Planning and Management for a Sustainable Future explains how careful, integrated land use planning can support economic growth, social fairness, and environmental protection. As cities grow rapidly and environmental pressures increase, especially due to climate change, effective planning is more important than ever, as decisions made today affect the communities and ecosystems of tomorrow. Sustainable land use cannot rely on separate, isolated strategies, since urban development, agriculture, forestry, transportation, and conservation are all interconnected. Decisions in one area often influence others, which is why this book uses systems thinking to show how planning tools, policies, and community involvement can work together to create landscapes that are both resilient and sustainable. Drawing on international case studies, policy analyses, and examples of best practices, the book explores traditional methods alongside newer approaches such as smart growth, green infrastructure, ecosystem-based management, and community-led planning. It highlights the importance of evidence-based decision-making, stakeholder participation, and flexible strategies, showing how collaboration among governments, planners, and communities can turn plans into action and achieve lasting impact.

title: Language and Reason in Islamic Thought
subtitle: Faḫr al-Dīn al-Rāzī’s Reconciliation of Manṭiq and Bayān
description: This study delves into Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī's (1149–1210) theory of language, a pivotal yet underexplored facet of his intellectual legacy. Moving beyond his interactions with the Avicennian tradition, it positions al-Rāzī as an independent thinker. The work examines two often misinterpreted dimensions of his thought: his assertion that all concepts are self-evident, challenging traditional epistemology on conceptualization ( taṣawwur ) as advanced by Abū Naṣr al-Fārābī (870–950) and Ibn Sīnā (980–1037), and his refinement of ʿAbd-l-Qāhir al-Ğurğānī’s (1009–1078) theory of linguistic composition ( naẓm ), emphasizing language’s expressive capacity ( bayān ) and the Qurʾān’s unique linguistic structure. By analyzing these facets, the study reconstructs al-Rāzī’s comprehensive framework for understanding linguistic phenomena, bridging the Greek-inspired falsafa tradition and the rich Arabic linguistic heritage. This exploration offers scholars and students a nuanced perspective on Islamic intellectual history, highlighting al-Rāzī’s role in harmonizing diverse traditions and advancing a profound theory of linguistic understanding. This theory is essential for engaging with al-Rāzī’s extensive written heritage.

title: Las tecnologías disruptivas: vía para la transformación del aprendizaje
description: Current technological transformations are redefining the ways of teaching, learning, and constructing knowledge within educational systems. Disruptive Technologies: A Pathway to the Transformation of Contemporary Learning analyzes this process from a critical and forward-looking perspective, focusing on the potential of educational robotics and generative artificial intelligence as drivers of pedagogical innovation. The book explores how these technologies, when integrated through coherent didactic and methodological approaches, strengthen active, interdisciplinary, and contextualized learning. Drawing on conceptual frameworks such as TPACK and STEM, the text proposes a balanced articulation among pedagogical knowledge, disciplinary expertise, and technological resources, highlighting the importance of intentional and reflective teacher mediation. One of the central contributions of the work is the design of a professional teacher training model aimed at developing competencies for formative management with disruptive technologies. This model takes shape in a structured, flexible, and assessable strategy that promotes continuous improvement in educational practice and its adaptation to diverse institutional contexts. Additionally, the book presents active methodologies, gamification dynamics, simulation, and collaborative work, along with educational experiences that demonstrate the impact of these technologies on motivation, creativity, and problem-solving. From an ethical and humanistic perspective, the book invites readers to rethink the teacher’s role as a designer of innovative and meaningful learning experiences. Addressed to teachers, researchers, and educational leaders, this text stands as an academic reference for those seeking to understand, plan, and implement transformative educational processes aligned with the demands of the present and the future.

title: Laserstrahlschweißen von Metallen mit niedrigsiedenden Legierungselementen
description: Themengebiete selektive Verdampfung und Kapillarinstabilitäten untersucht. Die Untersuchungen werden zum Großteil mit magnesium- und zinklegierten Aluminiumlegierungen durchgeführt, da diese Werkstoffe bereits für geringe Legierungsgehalte deutlich reduzierte Verdampfungstemperaturen aufweisen. Durch einen Abgleich von Stofftransportmodellen mit experimentellen Ergebnissen und der Anpassung von Materialkennwerten können die Modelle zur Vorhersage des Legierungselementverlustes und des Verdampfungsstroms niedrigsiedender Elemente genutzt werden. Als das wesentliche Ergebnis der Untersuchungen kann Blasensieden als Ursache von Kapillarinstabilitäten identifiziert werden. Das Phänomen wird umfassend charakterisiert und ein Entstehungsmechanismus vorgeschlagen, der die Erkenntnisse aus den Untersuchungen zur selektiven Verdampfung aufgreift. Darüber hinaus wird ein Kriterium für das Blasensieden formuliert.

title: Latest Research in Contaminants of Emerging Concern
description: This edited volume presents a comprehensive examination of contemporary issues in environmental contamination and ecological health. Focusing on emerging pollutants and their interactions within natural systems, it integrates perspectives from environmental chemistry, toxicology, and ecosystem science to illuminate the complex pathways through which contaminants affect biological and ecological integrity. The book offers an in-depth analysis of key environmental stressors, including pesticides, microplastics, and pharmaceutical residues, while addressing the mechanisms of toxicity, ecological consequences, and current approaches to mitigation. Through critical discussion of recent advances and methodological innovations, it highlights the importance of early warning indicators, sustainable remediation practices, and interdisciplinary frameworks for environmental assessment. Designed for researchers, graduate students, and professionals in the environmental sciences, this volume provides both foundational knowledge and critical insights into the management of emerging contaminants. Its synthesis of experimental findings, conceptual developments, and technological strategies underscores the need for continued collaboration between scientific inquiry and environmental policy. By situating current environmental challenges within a broader historical and scientific context, the volume encourages reflection on the evolving relationship between human activity and ecological stability. It contributes to an informed understanding of pollution dynamics, offering guidance toward more resilient and sustainable approaches to environmental stewardship.

title: Latest Research on Elaeis guineensis
description: Latest Research on Elaeis guineensis explores the multifaceted potential of oil palm, highlighting its significance in sustainable agriculture, environmental management, bio-based product development, and technological innovation. This edited volume provides a comprehensive overview of contemporary strategies to optimize oil palm production while promoting ecological stewardship and socioeconomic responsibility. Readers will gain insights into the use of oil palm biomass for renewable energy and value-added applications, the integration of sustainable agricultural practices, and the role of emerging technologies in enhancing efficiency and decision-making across the sector. By connecting environmental sustainability, industrial applications, and technological advancements, the book demonstrates how oil palm research can contribute to circular economy solutions, resource efficiency, and improved human health outcomes. Designed for researchers, industry professionals, policymakers, and students, this volume offers a clear, accessible synthesis of current trends, practical approaches, and conceptual frameworks that support responsible, innovative development in the oil palm industry. With its focus on both ecological and socioeconomic dimensions, the book serves as an essential resource for anyone seeking to understand the broader impact and opportunities of one of the world’s most versatile crops, making it a valuable guide for advancing sustainable practices, optimizing production systems, and fostering innovation in agriculture and related industries.

title: Lattanzio e la ›virtus‹
subtitle: La critica a Lucilio e Cicerone nel VI libro delle ›Divinae Institutiones‹
description: This volume assesses how the Satirist Lucilius (2nd century BC) and the statesman and orator Cicero (1st century BC), in their attempt at integrating mos maiorum and Greek virtue (ἀρετή), give the opportunity for the apologist Lactantius (3rd-4th century AD) to confront two witnesses of Roman cultural history in the field of “military” and “ethical” virtus : he remoulds their assertions through a strongly biased, but deeply conceived reenactment. In Div. inst. 6.5.1 ̶ 6.24, Lactantius rejects both the definitions of virtus exposed by Lucilius (vv. 1326 ̶ 1338 Marx) and Cicero’s reflections upon the officia vivendi and his notion of honestum (Off. 1.34 ̶ 41): one after the other, they are accordingly involved by the apologist in a vehement attack against the Roman empire. By regarding the pre-Christian empire as one based on injustice, Lactantius claims a demand for a restored virtus , grounded in agnitione Dei . After contrasting Lucilius’s stance about commoda patriai (v. 1337) as the peak of traditional Roman virtue, the apologist stigmatizes its underlying utilitarian ethics, and argues with the interplay between politics, law, and philosophy, on which Cicero allegedly founded the legitimacy of Roman expansionist imperialism.

title: Law, Nature and the Ecosystem Approach
subtitle: Modelling a Transcultural Eco-Legal Framework across Europe and Latin America
description: This book argues that, beyond the apparent fracture between humans and nature that defines the Anthropocene crisis, there exists a shared cultural foundation in legal traditions, converging on the recognition of the intrinsic value of Nature and of the ecosystem interconnections between human and non-human life. The legal innovations explored here—particularly from Latin America—embody a holistic, integrated view coherent with the ecosystem approach. It is proposed that these ideas offer potential not only within their own legal systems but also as models for Western legal frameworks. Divided into five parts, the book maintains a balance between theoretical and empirical, combining foundational legal and philosophical discussions with practical case studies and applications. Part 1 establishes the theoretical foundation, setting the conceptual framework of the volume. Part 2 builds on this by addressing the methodological implications and laying the groundwork for a transition from anthropocentric to ecocentric governance. Parts 3 and 4 bridge theory with practice, exploring participatory tools, bottom-up initiatives, and challenges to traditional environmental law, illustrating how theoretical advancements are applied in specific legal and policy contexts. Part 5 focuses on jurisprudence and the role of the judiciary, providing an empirical analysis of how legal principles are interpreted and enforced in judicial settings. This progression ensures that the book effectively integrates theory with empirical research, underscoring its interdisciplinary and practical significance. The volume will be of interest to those working in the areas of Legal Philosophy, Environmental Law, Constitutional Law, Comparative Law, Human Rights, Anthropology and Environmental Studies. The Open Access version of this book, available at http://www.taylorfrancis.com, has been made available under a Creative Commons Attribution- Non Commercial-Share Alike (CC-BY-NC-SA)] 4.0 license.

title: Lawyers, Gatekeeping and Access to Justice
subtitle: A Critical Analysis
description: Lawyers face increasing pressure from clients, politicians, prospective hires and international and civil society organisations to act as gatekeepers: to reject certain clients or cases or mitigate their involvement. This can be at variance with the traditional role of lawyers to provide access to justice. This volume presents a systematic exploration of the gatekeeping debate. It discusses the key dimensions of gatekeeping, the risk of abuse of identifying lawyers with their clients in authoritarian regimes, the limits of partisan lawyering and the legal boundaries to representation. It also discusses the question of representation that may be in line with professional duties but still be considered controversial based on soft law or moral or societal expectations. A key takeaway is that the gatekeeping discussion would benefit from the differentiation between whether a client deserves representation and how a lawyer should represent the client. The contributions are written by high-profile academics and professionals from various jurisdictions around the globe, aiming to provide solid, multifaceted, balanced and comprehensive guidance for lawyers, academic researchers, regulators, bar associations and law societies.

title: Leading for School Belonging
subtitle: How to Navigate the Way Ahead
description: In this open access book, international educator Kathryn Riley sends a powerful message: Whoever young people are, wherever they are from, however they learn, they deserve to be in schools where they feel safe, connected and have a sense of belonging. School belonging is about well-being, quality education, and aspiring to social equality. It is created by just and strong institutions, and through partnerships. Drawing on the traditions of engaged scholarship, Inspiring School Belonging links research to practice, highlighting the principles of school belonging (how they shape intentions, guide behaviour, influence actions); the practice (the features of daily school-life which matter); and the pathways (the journeys which schools can take to build alliances for belonging). The book presents a ‘theory of change for school belonging’ to guide readers to implement change in their own situations, along with vivid case studies to illustrate the process. The case studies include an international school exploring what belonging means for ‘third culture kids’; a group of special schools developing the voices of their students; and a secondary school in a challenging context, growing young people’s sense of agency. The book’s key arguments incorporate the findings of an international research study, The Bali 25 Global Leaders in Belonging Roundtable. Leading for School Belonging will be indispensable reading for leaders committed to fostering truly inclusive school environments. The ebook editions of this book are available open access under a CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0 licence on bloomsburycollections.com

title: Leukaemia
subtitle: Recent Advances in Diagnosis and Therapeutic Modalities
description: Leukaemia care is evolving at a breathtaking pace. Gone are the days of a one-size-fits-all approach. Today, groundbreaking discoveries in precision diagnostics and targeted therapies are revolutionizing patient outcomes and redefining hope. Leukaemia - Recent Advances in Diagnosis and Therapeutic Modalities provides a vital, up-to-the-minute overview of this dynamic field. This essential volume distills the latest scientific breakthroughs into a single, authoritative resource, bridging the gap between cutting-edge research and clinical application. Inside, leading experts guide you through: • Precision Diagnostics: The integration of next-generation sequencing, liquid biopsy, and advanced MRD monitoring to guide personalized treatment strategies. • Therapeutic Revolutions: In-depth coverage of paradigm-shifting modalities, including CAR T-cell immunotherapies, novel targeted small molecules, and next-generation monoclonal antibodies. • Integrated Management: Practical insights on managing novel toxicities, overcoming resistance, and the future role of stem cell transplantation in the modern era. • The Road Ahead: A forward-looking perspective on emerging biomarkers, combination strategies, and the challenges of translating innovation into accessible care. Comprehensive, concise, and clinically relevant, this book is a guide for haematologists, oncologists, paediatric oncologists, translational researchers, and advanced trainees. It is a critical resource for anyone dedicated to understanding and applying the innovations that are shaping the present and future of leukaemia treatment.
